about.title: Mō Redacto
about.summary: Ka hopu a Redacto i ngā raraunga whaiaro (ngā ingoa, ngā īmēra, ngā ID, ngā muna i roto i te waehere) i mua i tō whakapiri ki ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini rānei, ka whakawhiti mō ngā puriwāhi ka taea e koe te whakaora ā muri ake.
about.local: Ka haere katoa te haurapa i tō pūrere. Kāore he mea e whakapiria e koe e puta atu i te pūtirotiro, ā, kāore he ine waea.
about.fork: Ko Redacto he waka koreutu, kore-arumoni o Privacy Guardrail mai i DFKI. Kāore i te whai wāhi, i tautokona rānei e DFKI.

legal.disclaimer: He āwhina anake a Redacto, ā, ka hapa, ka hē rānei te kara i ngā ihirangi tairongo. Arotakea ngā kuputuhi i ngā wā katoa i mua i tō tukunga.
history.title: Hītori
history.empty: Kāore anō kia ingoamunatia. Ko ngā whakapiri ka arotakea e koe i ChatGPT, Claude me Gemini, me ngā kuputuhi ka ingoamuna koe i te ripa Anonymize, whakaaturia mai ki konei.
history.truncated: Kupu roa: ko te tīmatanga anake e puritia ana ki konei. Kāore e pāngia te whakaora.

Tāpirihia ngā pae e hiahia ana koe ki te pupuri, tae atu ki ō rātou roheroto. Ka whakakapia tonutia ngā hononga e mau ana i ngā taipitopito tuakiri, ngā tohutohu, ngā kaitāutu whaiaro rānei.

vault.title: Whare taupoki tuakiri
vault.intro1: Kotahi te penapena i ia tuakiri i kitea, ā, ka whakamahia anōtia ki ngā wāhi katoa. Takahuri
vault.intro2: aratau hei whakakapi i ngā puriwāhi pēnei i
vault.intro3: me ngā uara whaitake, engari e mārama ana, pēnei i te
vault.intro4: , e whakapai ake ana i te kounga urupare LLM. Pinea he pūkete hei maukati i tōna whakakapinga ki ngā huringa aunoa.
vault.empty: Kei te putu te taupuni. Ka puta mai ngā pūkete ki konei ina whakaū koe i ngā whakahōunga.

pasteReview.label: Ina kitea he raraunga whaiaro
pasteReview.body: Ka tukua e te ā-ringa ngā whakahōutanga ki tētahi matapihi pakū-ake, e taea ai e koe te arotake i mua i te whakapiri. Ka whakahōu aunoa i ngā tūemi ka tīpako tōmua te pakū-ake i tēnei wā tonu, me te kore whakaatu.
pasteReview.manual: Ā-ringa — tāpae i roto i tētahi pakū-ake
cancel.title: Whakapiri whakakorenga karapa
cancel.label: I te wā e whakakore ana i tētahi karapa
cancel.body: Kōwhiria he aha te mahi a Redacto ki te whakapiri tārewa i muri i tō whakakorenga mārama i tētahi karapa e haere ana. Ka karohia e te "Whakapiri me te kore taki" te haurapa raraunga-whaiaro mō taua whakapiri.
code.title: Ngā paraka waehere
code.hint: Ngā mea ngaro i roto i te whakahaere waehere me te rohe-waehere
code.secrets: Rapua ngā muna i roto i te waehere
code.secrets.hintBefore: Ka haki i ngā kī API me ngā maimai (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Stripe, Slack, Google, JWT), ngā paraka kī tūmataiti, ngā taipitopito tuakiri i ngā tautapatanga me ngā aho tūhononga, ngā ingoa kaihautū ā-roto pēnei i
code.secrets.hintAfter: , me ngā ingoa kaiwhakamahi i ngā ara whaiaronga-kāinga.
code.rename: Whakaingoa anō i ngā kaitāutu waehere
code.rename.hint1: Ka whakaingoa anō i ngā akomanga, ngā taumahi, ngā tāupe, ngā āpure me ngā tawhā e whakapuakina ana e te waehere whakapiri, kia rite ki ngā wāhi katoa:
code.rename.hint5: . Ka noho tonu ngā ingoa kawemai, puna hoki. Ko ngā ingoa e kitea ai e AI Paetata ngā raraunga whaiaro, ka puritia kētia tētahi puriwāhi patohia (
code.rename.hint6: ). Mā te tārua waehere mai i tētahi whakautu e whakaora i ngā ingoa taketake. Mā te whakakā i tēnei ka whakakā hoki i te haurapa muna.
code.shareLanguage: Whakamahia tētahi reo i kitea māia i ngā wāhi katoa
code.shareLanguage.hintBefore: Ina mōhiotia tētahi paraka waehere o tētahi whakapiri i runga i te maia nui (he tapanga taiapa pēnei i
code.shareLanguage.hintAfter: , wetereo kāore rānei i te mōhiotia), ka pānuitia hoki ērā atu paraka me ngā kongakonga ki taua reo: ōna wetereo me ōna ingoa whaimana, kāore i whakaingoatia anōtia. Ko ngā paraka e mōhiotia ana he reo rerekē e pupuri ana i ō rātou ake.
code.highlight: Miramira wetereo mō tētahi reo e mōhiotia ana
code.highlight.hintBefore: Ina mōhiotia te reo o tētahi paraka waehere i runga i te maia nui (he tapanga taiapa pēnei i
code.highlight.hintAfter: , te wetereo kāore rānei i te mōhiotia), ka whakaaturia te waehere i ia āpure o te paewhiri taha ki te tae wetereo o taua reo: te kupu hei ingoamuna me tōna hua, me te whakautu hei whakaora me te kupu kua whakaoratia. Ko ngā kongakonga poto o te whakautu ka tae ki te reo o te whakapiri taketake. Ko ngā paraka e mōhiotia ana hei reo kē e pupuri ana i tō rātou ake.
code.skip.hintBefore: Ina kā, ko ngā kitenga i roto i ngā paraka tautohu taiapa me
code.skip.hintAfter: Ka neke ngā rohe ki tētahi whakaaturanga tiango i roto i te paparua, kaua e puta ki te taumata o runga. Ka karapahia ngā backticks rōraina i ngā wā katoa.
search.title: Rapu tukutuku
search.label: Parea ngā rapunga tukutuku
search.body1Before: Taki ai i ngā mea e whakapiria ana e koe ki te pouaka rapu o tētahi pūkaha rapu, ā, ka puritia ia rapunga kia takina rā anō te uiui. Ka whakakapia ngā raraunga whaiaro e whakaaetia ana e koe ki ngā puriwāhi pēnei i te
search.body1After: i mua i te tukunga o te rapu. Mā te whakakā i tēnei ka tono i te pūtirotiro kia uru ki ēnei pae rapu.
search.body2: Kāore i hipokina: ko ngā rapunga i patohia ki te pae wāhitau o te pūtirotiro, e kore rawa e tae ki te whārangi, me ngā huatau e tonoa ana e tētahi pūkaha rapu i a koe e pato ana. Whakawetohia ngā huatau rapu i ngā tautuhinga pūkaha mō te parenga tino kaha.
search.declined: Kāore i tukuna te āheitanga ki ngā pae rapu, nā reira ka weto tonu te parenga.
